phases.note: ContextComposer composes fixed-priority groups under an explicit caller budget: contract/work -> effective decisions -> project facts -> conversation -> artifact metadata -> raw files. Groups only read granted kinds; global byte/token/slice caps hold; incomplete decision scans fail the whole composition; cross-project items and missing providers are explicit; content stays untrusted_data; deterministic for fixed now.

confirmWithCommand validates plan input before confirming (needs_user_input keeps pending), confirms with the main-owned effectCommandId, and returns the existing UserCommand for same-transaction dispatch. Reply has no effect; duplicate confirmation replays one command; another command id conflicts.

Real SQLite lifecycle: reject is a distinct terminal state (never a command), revoke keeps audit but leaves effective knowledge, source-digest drift blocks commit with no row, mid-transaction receipt failure rolls back proposal+decision+event+receipt, supersede-then-revoke never reactivates the original, reopen keeps statuses. decisionContextProvider exposes effective-only decisions with scan_incomplete propagation.
